access.description: Whether the injected credential is read-only or may perform ordinary writes within its scope.

scope.description: Where the injected workload credential may operate: only this namespace or the whole cluster.

attribute.description: Node attribute or label key to match, such as arch, os, or a custom label.

value.description: Exact value the selected node must report for this attribute.

command.description: Command argv executed for a script health check.

interval.description: Delay between health checks. Omit to use the Trellis default.

path.description: HTTP request path; ignored by TCP and script checks.

port.description: Port checked by HTTP or TCP health checks.

threshold.description: Consecutive failed checks required before unhealthy. Zero uses the Trellis default.

timeout.description: Maximum duration of one health check. Omit to use the Trellis default.

type.description: Health-check implementation: http, tcp, or script.

port.description: Node port Trellis reserves and the process must bind directly when using host networking.

cpu.description: CPU request in millicores; 1000 represents one CPU core.

memory.description: Memory request as bytes or a readable decimal/binary size such as 500MB or 256MiB.

max_restarts.description: Maximum failures allowed inside the restart window. Zero disables retries.

window.description: Time window used to count restart attempts.

env.description: Environment variable name used by an env target.

mode.description: File mode for a file target: 0400 or 0600 (or decimal 256/384). Zero uses the default.

name.description: Name of a stored secret in this job's namespace.

path.description: Destination path below /run/trellis-secrets/ used by a file target.

api_access.description: Optional least-privilege Trellis API credential request for every task in this group.

constraints.description: Exact node attribute or label matches required for placement.

count.description: Desired number of allocations for this task group.

labels.description: Discovery and routing metadata attached to allocations from this group.

name.description: Task-group identifier, unique within this job.

restart.description: Retry policy for task failures inside an allocation.

runtime.description: Optional OCI runtime override. Omit to use the node default; supported explicit values are runc and runsc.

tasks.description: Containers colocated in every allocation of this group; they share placement, scaling, update, restart, and drain lifecycle.

update.description: How allocations from an older job revision are replaced.

mode.description: Network attachment: isolated, host, or the private Trellis namespace network. Omission means isolated.

ports.description: Direct host-port reservations. Valid only with mode: host; Trellis does not perform NAT or port translation.

env.description: Literal environment variables. Keep credentials in Trellis secrets instead of manifest text.

health_check.description: Optional HTTP, TCP, or script readiness/health observation. A running task without one is considered healthy.

image.description: Pullable OCI image reference. Pin a version or digest for reproducible deployments.

name.description: Task identifier, unique within this task group.

networking.description: Network attachment and, for host mode, direct node-port reservations.

resources.description: CPU and memory requested from the scheduler for each task instance.

secrets.description: Stored namespace secrets delivered to the task as environment variables or files.

volumes.description: Namespace-scoped named volumes. First placement registers a volume to one node; later allocations using the same namespace/name are scheduled there.

max_parallel.description: Maximum not-yet-healthy rolling replacements in flight. Zero uses Trellis's effective default of one.

strategy.description: Replacement strategy. Omit for recreate; rolling starts healthy replacement capacity incrementally.

container_path.description: Absolute mount path inside the container.

host_path.description: Node-side backing directory. @/ is resolved below Trellis's namespace volume root; absolute paths are used verbatim and are not namespace-isolated on disk.

name.description: Stable namespace-scoped volume identity used for placement.

read_only.description: Mount this volume read-only when true.

description: Schema for the first-party human-authored YAML representation. Trellis itself consumes canonical JSON after the consumer converts human quantities.

name.description: Job identifier, unique within its namespace.

namespace.description: Namespace that owns the job and all runtime allocations created for it.

task_groups.description: One or more placement, scaling, update, restart, and draining units.

title: Trellis job manifest
